items.source: Note: The underlying standard WebSocket session (JSR-356) does not allow concurrent sending. Therefore, sending must be synchronized. To ensure that, one option is to wrap the WebSocketSession with the ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator.
items.translation: 注意： 底层的标准 WebSocket 会话（JSR-356）不允许并发发送。因此，必须对发送操作进行同步。为确保这一点，一种选择是使用 ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator 包装 WebSocketSession。

items.source:
Polling and Streaming sessions periodically close the current HTTP request and
wait for the next request to come through.
items.translation: 轮询和流式传输会话会定期关闭当前的 HTTP 请求，并等待下一个请求的到来。

items.source:
Disable the SockJS heartbeat, presumably because a higher-level protocol
has heartbeats enabled for the session already. It is not recommended to
disable this otherwise, as it helps proxies to know the connection is
not hanging.
items.translation: 禁用 SockJS 心跳，可能是因为更高层级的协议已经为会话启用了心跳。否则不建议禁用此功能，因为它有助于代理服务器确认连接未挂起。

items.source:
Polling and Streaming sessions periodically close the current HTTP request and
wait for the next request to come through. During this "downtime" the session is
still open but inactive and unable to send messages and therefore has to buffer
them temporarily. A WebSocket session by contrast is stateful and remain active
until closed.
items.translation: 轮询和流式传输会话会定期关闭当前的 HTTP 请求并等待下一个请求的到来。在此期间，“停机”时间内，会话仍然处于打开状态但不活动，无法发送消息，因此必须暂时缓冲这些消息。相比之下，WebSocket 会话是有状态的，并在关闭前保持活动状态。
